description: This Java test source file contains integration tests for client external ID management in the Apache Fineract system. It tests behaviors related to client creation, updating, deletion, and status changes, especially focusing on external ID handling under various configuration settings.

classes.name: ClientExternalIdTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that verifies external ID functionalities for clients in the Fineract system, including creation, update, deletion, and status transitions, with configurations toggling auto-generated external IDs.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup, request/response specifications, and configuration helper before each test.

methods.name: whenAutoExternalIdConfigIsOffCreateClient
methods.description: Tests creating a client when auto external ID generation is disabled; expects no external ID to be assigned.

methods.name: whenAutoExternalIdConfigIsOffCreateClientWithValue
methods.description: Tests creating a client with a specified external ID when auto generation is off; verifies the external ID is set correctly.

methods.name: whenAutoExternalIdConfigIsOnCreateClient
methods.description: Tests creating a client with auto external ID generation enabled; expects a generated external ID of length 36.

methods.name: whenAutoExternalIdConfigIsOnCreateClientWithValue
methods.description: Tests creating a client with a specified external ID while auto-generation is enabled; expects external ID to match the provided value.

methods.name: testClientStatusUsingExternalId
methods.description: Verifies client status transitions (ACTIVE, CLOSED, PENDING, REJECTED) using external ID and performs status change actions.

methods.name: testUpdateClientUsingExternalId
methods.description: Tests updating client information keyed by external ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClientUsingExternalId
methods.description: Tests deleting (closing/reactivating) a client identified by external ID.

methods.name: testGetClientAccountsUsingExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves client accounts using external ID.

methods.name: testGetClientTransferProposalDate
methods.description: Fetches the proposed transfer date for a client specified by external ID.

methods.name: testGetClientObligeeData
methods.description: Gets obligee data for a client using external ID.

methods.name: fetchClientByExternalId
methods.description: Helper method to verify and retrieve client data by external ID.
